description: Test of helpdesk recovery in the ops core (S8b, feature A23): an IT desk that resets a password or moves a second sign-in step to the owner's own phone after checking the caller, an ID desk that does it only while you hold the owner's phone, a request form opened in person, over a PC and from a call, and a sign-in that shows what changed. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove a desk resets only after its rule is met and stops serving a name after repeated refusals, an unknown name looks the same as a wrong answer, a reset password replaces the old one and makes saved connections stale until typed once, a second-step reset moves the step to the owner's own phone, and no answer shows a recovery answer or a code early
